sources.title: Qwen 3.8 Flash vs GLM 5.3 Flash: Which Open Source Model Works for NSFW ...
sources.snippet: We tested Qwen 3.8-27B and GLM 5.3 Flash for uncensored NSFW use. Compare abliteration support, hardware requirements, context windows, and real-world performance in this hands-on comparison.

sources.title: zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3-Flash starts from a newly trained base model, with its architecture and training recipe redesigned around capability and efficiency. For the first time in the GLM series, we introduce a hybrid architecture combining sparse and linear attention, sharply reducing long-context serving costs while preserving precise long-context capabilities.

sources.title: orcarouter.ai - One AI gateway: adaptive LLM routing & governance
sources.snippet: An AI router sits between your app and many models and picks the best model for each request. OrcaRouter grades every prompt in under 1 ms and routes it — frontier for hard reasoning, open-source for routine — across 200+ models at zero token markup.

sources.title: zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash | vLLM Recipes - recipes.vllm.ai
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3-Flash is a 320B-total / 18B-active multimodal MoE with hybrid KDA and sparse MLA attention, native FP8 weights, MTP, and a 1M-token context window.
